options.approach: Investigate structural results for forbidden graphs with bounded additive Turán error. Try to prove that their edge-extremal constructions always include a cycle maximizer, rather than continuing to search for bounded-error counterexamples.

options.approach: Search larger forbidden graphs and larger finite within-part configurations while retaining every between-part edge. Compare the maximum total number of added edges with the cycle-weighted optimum for odd orders.
